arguments.sql: SELECT m.mcc, c.description, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_count, COUNT(*) AS labelled_count, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate FROM transactions t INNER JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) INNER JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id INNER JOIN mcc_codes c ON m.mcc = c.mcc GROUP BY m.mcc, c.description HAVING SUM(f.is_fraud) >= 50 ORDER BY fraud_rate DESC, m.mcc ASC
arguments.explanation: Lists each MCC with at least 50 fraud-labelled transactions, with its fraud count, labelled transaction count and fraud rate over labelled transactions, highest rate first.
assumptions: Fraud rate is computed over labelled transactions only (inner join to fraud_labels); unlabelled transactions are excluded.
MCC is taken from the merchant's mcc (transactions -> merchants -> mcc_codes).
'At least 50 transactions labelled as fraud' means SUM(is_fraud) >= 50 per MCC.
Results are ordered by fraud rate descending, then MCC ascending for stable ties.
